$schema: Single source of truth for public website routes + supported locales. Consumed by client/scripts/generate-sitemap.js (sitemap.xml emission) and client/scripts/prerender.js (per-locale Playwright capture). Cross-referenced by workers/og-router/worker.js's ROUTE_OG (which keeps a hand-maintained subset for crawler-served meta tags — Cloudflare Workers cannot import JSON at module-init under the current wrangler.toml configuration). Updating this file is the single touch-point for adding a new public route to both the sitemap and the prerender matrix; ROUTE_OG must be updated by hand in the same commit and the cross-link comment in worker.js calls that out.
